description: Change your avatar's outfit in a named wardrobe slot. Wire PDU: VMNetSetOutfitCmd (tso.simantics/NetPlay/Model/Commands/VMNetSetOutfitCmd.cs). Prerequisite: you are present on a lot with a live VM replica (no EOD is required — the stock client only exposes this through Dresser/Rack/Trunk, but the server-side Verify is unconditional so the primitive is callable directly). Effect: the targeted outfit slot on your VMAvatar is replaced with the new outfit_id. The new value is readable in subsequent query-self responses under the 'outfits' object. Decoration scopes (head/back/shoes/tail) mutate the Decoration struct, same roundtrip. The server does not validate the outfit_id against the avatar's owned-outfit set, so agents should source ids from query-self's current outfit fields or from an inventory read. Cost: none. Refuse: outfit_id=0, unknown scope string.

args.name: outfit_id
args.description: 64-bit outfit asset id. Must be non-zero. Sourced from query-self.outfits.* or a prior successful change-outfit.

args.name: scope
args.description: Which slot to replace. Accepted: dynamic-daywear, dynamic-sleepwear, dynamic-swimwear, dynamic-costume, default-daywear, default-sleepwear, default-swimwear, decoration-head, decoration-back, decoration-shoes, decoration-tail. dynamic-* overrides default-* at render time; use dynamic-daywear for a live-session wardrobe change.

call_signatures: cf $CF change-outfit --outfit_id <id> --scope default-sleepwear                                             # scopes: dynamic-daywear/sleepwear/swimwear/costume, default-daywear/sleepwear/swimwear, decoration-head/back/shoes/tail
common_mistakes: Unknown --scope → ok:false with the full accepted-scope list.
Dynamic scopes override default scopes at render time when non-zero; the VMAvatar state reflects both independently.
perception_hints: Your current name / shard: perception.avatar.name, perception.avatar.shard
Current outfit (via query-self, not perception): use query-self → .outfits
refuse_conditions: outfit_id == 0 → ok:false with 'outfit_id must be non-zero'
unknown scope string → ok:false with the full accepted list
